title: Brookfield Asset Management Inc - proposed acquisition of Multiplex Group
industries: Property development and property funds management

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: On 12 June 2007, the Multiplex Board announced it was supporting a takeover bid from Brookfield Asset Management.
body_sections.Market definition: Given the lack of any overlap, the ACCC did not need to conclusively define the relevant markets for this matter. However, this merger was assessed within the context of: - the national market for construction services; - regional markets for property development services; and - the national market for property funds management and facilities management.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 28 June 2007, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets, given that Brookfield Asset Management does not have any interests in areas that overlap with Multiplex in Australia.
